payload.name: pc-check-flag
payload.description: Pure-logic validator that accepts only the exact booleans True and False. Reads the raw flag from inputs.get('flag') so a missing key is a valid invalid-result (not an exception). Returns {valid: boolean, flag: original boolean when valid else null}. Uses a small helper check_flag and invokes it at module scope to assign result on every outcome. No imports, I/O, host calls, exceptions, coercion or eval/exec/open.
